audit_scope: Read-only. No controller experiments, no simulation, no production or design-file edits. One read-only arithmetic check on the existing 2024 forecast fixture.
verdict_rationale: No candidate is ready as written. Candidate 1 can be infeasible and pushes diesel up under J2 priority. Candidate 4 attributes 68.4% to step-0 when that figure is total EBR-removal fuel. Candidate 2 is closest, but its night-wind clamp is inactive on the named test origins. Every candidate needs the corrections below. Headline percentages and the 100% reliability guarantee are unsupported.

Justify the floor by a diesel start-delay measurement, or label it a governance choice.
Test one mechanism at a time (floor alone, or wind clamp alone) on the full 123-origin set.

terminal_target.label: VERIFIED_PARTIAL
terminal_target.evidence: TERMINAL_ABLATION_REPORT: removal gives -14.6% fuel (-56.6 L) and -10.2% curtailment, and +6.3% unmet (+20.2 kWh) across six origins. Partial contributor, not primary mechanism.
terminal_target.design_claim_status: Design says additional 10-14% saving with no reliability cost: PARTIAL and misleading.
terminal_target.recommendation: Keep as a separate experiment with reliability cost reported.

hybrid_assessment.label: UNSUPPORTED
issues: Changes three mechanisms at once. Terminal pruning has no isolated arm.
Acceptance criterion (critical_unmet = 0.0) conflicts with terminal evidence (+6.3% unmet) unless other mechanisms offset it. No offset shown.

ranking_assessment.label: UNSUPPORTED
ranking_assessment.reason: Scores (9.4, 8.6, 8.1, 7.5) and percentage ranges have no defined scoring function or computation.

experiment_protocol_assessment.label: CORRECTION_REQUIRED
issues: Test origins (56, 77, 66, 23, 8, 30) are the diagnosis origins. No held-out set.
Six origins cannot support the significance tests the design requires. The 123-origin campaign is the one that could.
Origins 8 and 30 are not clean controls: origin 8 changes -19.3 L in the terminal ablation, origin 30 unchanged.
Acceptance criteria require 100% critical reliability and -25% fuel without basis.

best_candidate_to_implement_first.answer: None as written. For research, Candidate 2 with corrections (all-hours wind clamp, no solar credit beyond pre-registered de-rating), tested on the full 123-origin set against an unchanged control.
best_candidate_to_implement_first.reason: Changes one mechanism (reserve sizing), has a clear safety argument for the wind channel, needs no new model. Candidate 4 avoids forecasts but depends on a diesel start delay the repo does not contain. Candidate 1 is infeasible as written.

unverified_items: Whether a production config overrides the EBR default (no ebr_target_wh key found in config files).
Campaign origin dates for 77, 66, 23, 8, 30 (fixture IDs do not map to campaign IDs; only 2024-06-25 and 2024-07-05 confirmed by date).
Whether startup_fuel_l is set anywhere outside the code default.
Git status of design and production files (not run).
Stated SOC figures (90-95% pre-dawn) against trace data.
